Sophie L: Heads-up — we should schedule the inference benchmark readout for the latency / cost dashboards. Wanted to get a slot before EOW. Proposed agenda: 1) latest config & kernels, 2) benchmark readout (p99, median, throughput), 3) cost-per-token deltas, 4) rollout gating decision.
Owen K: I can do Thu or Fri mornings PT. 30-45m should be enough if we keep slides tight.
Mira: Thu 10am PT works for me. prefer 45m for Qs.
Ana P: Fri is better for me (customer review Thurs). If we do Thu pls record.
Sophie L: OK — tentative Thu 10am PT, 45m. @Jesse can you own invite + add links? :calendar:
Jesse: Yep will create invite. Can you drop the pre-reads?
Owen K: Pre-reads: dashboard snapshot + small perf-run notes at https://redwood.internal/bench/175600 (artifacts + script).
Ana P: Quick ask — include cost delta table vs last stable (model-v12) and note any quantization experiments (4-bit/awq).
Mira: Also add the recent failing case from PR #457 as a slide (latency spike reproduction).
DevOps Bot: CI perf run completed for commit abc123, artifacts uploaded: https://redwood.internal/ci/artifacts/891 :white_check_mark:
Owen K: For running local microbench: ```./scripts/run_bench --model model-v13 --seq 1024 --iters 100 --quant 4```
Sophie L: Nice. Action items: Jesse create invite + recording, Owen attach dashboard snapshots, Ana add cost table, Mira add PR repro steps. Will we need eng-runtime in the call?
Jesse: I'll add eng-runtime and runtime-oncall. Invite sent to Thu 2025-11-06 10:00 PT, 45m, includes recording enabled + agenda + links.
Ana P: Thanks — I'll upload the cost CSV to the invite and pin key charts in the dashboard.
Mira: If anyone can't make Thu, pls reply here with alternative times. Otherwise we'll treat this as the sync and share recording. :thumbsup:
Sophie L: Thanks all — see you Thu.
